title: Required field is not identified programmatically
description: The date field is required to continue, but the input has neither a required attribute nor aria-required, and the label does not say so.
expectedBehaviour: A field that must be completed is identified as required programmatically.
actualBehaviour: The input has no required or aria-required attribute and no visible required indicator.
userImpact: Screen-reader users are not told that the field is required until submission fails.

observed.note: Page-level axe run with tags wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa and best-practice. No violation was reported for this page in its default state; the control on the same page also passes.

detection.note: Static and accessibility-tree inspection both expose the missing state.

manualTests: Move to the date field in forms mode and listen for whether it is announced as required.

assistiveTechnologyTests.procedure: Navigate to the target with the VoiceOver rotor and confirm what is announced.

assertions: #date-a has no required attribute; #date-b has required.
tests: tests/subtle-defects.spec.js: keeps variant A errors unassociated, unfocused and linked to nothing

reviewStatus.note: A Playwright regression test preserves the defective behaviour and its control. That is automated reproduction, not a manual or assistive-technology observation.
